symptom: JSON Schema minLength:1 accepts whitespace-only values that the JavaScript runtime rejects. A generic regex \S also differs between Python and ECMAScript on U+FEFF and U+0085.
lesson: Portable JSON Schema nonblank checks must match ECMAScript trim explicitly; generic \S has engine-dependent semantics. U+FEFF is trim-whitespace in JavaScript while U+0085 is not.
guardrail: Use an explicit ECMAScript trim whitespace character class for all 23 nonblank schema constraints, and regression-test the same 42 Unicode probes in Node and a Draft 2020-12 schema validator before publishing.
